text: Setting clear project goals is essential for success. One useful approach is to use SMART goals, which means goals should be specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound. This helps the team understand exactly what needs to be done and when. It is also important to define milestones, which are key points in the project timeline that show progress. Deliverables, such as reports or final products, should be clearly identified so everyone knows what to expect. Finally, stakeholder alignment matters because all involved parties need to agree on the goals from the start.
